item.title: Japan’s Katayama flags FX “urgency” as Takaichi fiscal push keeps yen pressured
item.description: Summary:Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan is watching the yen’s slide “with a strong sense of urgency” and is in close communication with the US. The warning lands as PM Sanae Takaichi pushes a more expansionary fiscal stance that markets see as yen-negative at the margin. Takaichi has also nominated two dovish-leaning BOJ board candidates, prompting fresh concern about policy direction and BOJ independence. item.title: Germany January import price index +1.1% vs -0.1% m/m prior
item.description: German import prices rose strongly in January, reflecting the strongest monthly jump since January last year. But compared to the same month a year ago, import prices are seen down 2.3%. Once again, that is largely due to a drag in energy prices - down by over 21% in that period.
